FAQ

Common Questions

Straight answers before you reach out. Still curious? I'm a message away.

Most clients see qualified leads within the first 1–2 weeks of launch, since Google Ads is a pull channel. Meaningful, stable cost-per-lead improvements usually show up over the first 60–90 days as I gather data and optimize.

No. I work month-to-month. I ask for a 90-day minimum commitment because that's roughly how long it takes an account to mature, but you're never locked into a long-term contract.

A full teardown of your current account (or a competitive/market audit if you're new to ads): keyword coverage, wasted spend, quality score issues, landing page fit, and a prioritized action plan — no obligation to sign up.

Yes. On my Growth and Scale plans I design and test dedicated landing pages built to convert your ad traffic, plus ongoing A/B testing to keep improving conversion rate over time.

You get a clear monthly report covering leads, cost per lead, ad spend, and ROI, plus a live dashboard you can check anytime. Growth and Scale clients also get regular strategy calls to walk through the numbers together.

I focus on local and service-based businesses and don't currently take on adult, gambling, or MLM-style offers. If you're unsure whether your business fits, just ask — I'm happy to tell you honestly.

You do, always. I build and manage campaigns inside a Google Ads account that belongs to you, so your data, history, and performance stay yours even if you ever decide to work with someone else.

Yes. I set up conversion tracking, call tracking, and Google Analytics from day one so every dollar of ad spend is tied to a real, measurable result — not just clicks.
